Initial commit: P-PA6.4 Management System

- Backend: FastAPI with PostgreSQL integration
  - System functions \(sysfuction\) CRUD with constraint handling
  - User management, roles, and organizations
  - Authentication and authorization with JWT
  - i18n support for API responses

- Frontend: React TypeScript with i18n
  - System function settings with CRUD operations
  - Dynamic field disabling based on function type \(node/function\)
  - Multilingual support \(zh-TW, en\)
  - User/role/organization management pages
  - Permission configuration with i18n labels

- Database: PostgreSQL schema with constraints
  - Check constraints for data integrity \(chk_func_module\)
  - JSONB fields for flexible permissions
  - module_item as string array for permission types

- Configuration: Environment setup, CORS, static files
- Fixed: Database constraint handling for node vs function types
- Fixed: Multiple backend process conflicts

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
